statement: Let delta(v) = 1 if v is odd and 2 if v is even. For nodes i and v, let W(i,v) = 0 if i = v, and otherwise let W(i,v) be the sum of delta(x) over the nodes x on the unique simple path from i to v in the tree, excluding i and including v. The function returns a result r such that len(r) = n and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] is the maximum of W(i,v) over all v with 0 <= v < n. Equivalently, r[i] is the time when all nodes become marked if node i is marked at time 0 and all other nodes are initially unmarked.
preconditions: Let n = len(edges) + 1. The input satisfies 2 <= n <= 100000; len(edges) = n - 1; every edges[j] for 0 <= j < len(edges) has length 2; for every such j, 0 <= edges[j][0] < n and 0 <= edges[j][1] < n; and the undirected graph with vertices 0,...,n-1 and an edge between a and b iff some j has (edges[j][0]=a and edges[j][1]=b) or (edges[j][0]=b and edges[j][1]=a) is a tree (connected and acyclic).
